items.title: 66086_Zilner T. Randolph oral history interview
items.q: I had drums -- Richard Barnett... Prentice McCarey on piano, Richard Barnett on drums, Bill Oldham on bass

ctx.x: It was a good one, huh?
Yes. I had drums -- Richard Barnett,
he's gone. He was a drummer, he's dead. Bill Oldham on bass violin, his brother on alto, the boy that's on tenor, he's dead now -- Leon Washington.
